# truenas_network_interface (Resource)

Manages a TrueNAS network interface. BRIDGE, LINK_AGGREGATION, and VLAN interfaces can be created, updated, and deleted. A PHYSICAL interface is hardware: it cannot be created or deleted, but once imported it can be managed — its IP configuration (ipv4_dhcp, ipv6_auto, aliases, mtu, description) is updated like any other interface. Changes are staged and then committed with an auto-rollback safety window.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_network_interface" "br0" {
  name = "br0"
  type = "BRIDGE"

  bridge_members = ["enp8s0"]

  aliases = [
    {
      address = "192.168.10.1"
      netmask = 24
      type    = "INET"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Interface name, e.g. br0, bond0, vlan100.
- `type` (String) Interface type: BRIDGE, LINK_AGGREGATION, VLAN, or PHYSICAL. PHYSICAL interfaces cannot be created or deleted (the hardware exists independently of Terraform); import an existing physical interface, then manage its IP configuration. The type-specific fields (bridge_members/stp/enable_learning, lag_*, vlan_*) are not valid on a PHYSICAL interface.

### Optional

- `aliases` (Attributes List) Static IP address aliases assigned to this interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aliases))
- `bridge_members` (List of String) Member interfaces for a BRIDGE.
- `description` (String) Optional interface description.
- `enable_learning` (Boolean) BRIDGE only: enable MAC-address learning on the bridge.
- `ipv4_dhcp` (Boolean) Enable DHCP for IPv4.
- `ipv6_auto` (Boolean) Enable SLAAC autoconfiguration for IPv6.
- `lacpdu_rate` (String) LINK_AGGREGATION (LACP) only: LACPDU transmit rate, SLOW or FAST.
- `lag_ports` (List of String) Member ports for a LINK_AGGREGATION interface.
- `lag_protocol` (String) Link aggregation protocol (LINK_AGGREGATION only, "" = unset).
- `mtu` (Number) MTU size (0 = unset, uses the default).
- `stp` (Boolean) Enable spanning tree protocol (BRIDGE only).
- `vlan_parent_interface` (String) Parent interface for a VLAN.
- `vlan_pcp` (Number) VLAN only: 802.1p priority code point (0-7).
- `vlan_tag` (Number) VLAN tag ID (0 = unset).
- `xmit_hash_policy` (String) LINK_AGGREGATION only: transmit hash policy, LAYER2, LAYER2+3, or LAYER3+4.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Interface name (same as name).

<a id="nestedatt--aliases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aliases`

Required:

- `address` (String) IP address.
- `netmask` (Number) Netmask/prefix length.

Optional:

- `type` (String) Address family: INET, INET6.
